annotations.title: An allocation ETF against its benchmark

description: How an allocation ETF did against the ETFIQ benchmark for its band (set by the fund's look-through stock share), over the same dates: total returns by window and the difference, risk and cost, as ETFIQ published them for that fund. Takes a ticker such as AOR. Refuses, and estimates nothing, when ETFIQ has not published a comparison for the fund.
name: compare_to_benchmark
